As the new delegate, I am assigning this task to you. Your goal is to diagnose the root cause of this memory leak and come up with a solution to prevent it from occurring in the future.

1. The timeline of when the memory leak started occurring
2. The number of events processed before the memory leak occurs
3. The code for the billing service
4. The configuration of the message queue
Please review this information carefully and reach out to me if you have any questions or need further assistance.
Thank you for your attention to this matter.
Sincerely, [Your Name]
